headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Space, an office-suite-like work hub
summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Space, a shared hub for work projects and personal AI agents, along with tools to create documents and presentations inside ChatGPT — features likened to a Google Workspace alternative. ChatGPT is also coming to Slack and Microsoft Teams, putting OpenAI in more direct competition with traditional office-software companies.
